name: Ping'an International Financial Center
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Convention & Exhibition Center → L1 Shopping Park (3 stops)
why: Free Sky deck on 116F (547 m). ¥180 online / ¥200 on site; 10:00-20:00 (Fri-Sat 21:00). Enter ~16:30 for sunset. Metro: 购物公园 Exit D.

name: Museum of Contemporary Art & Planning Exhibition
chinese_name: 深圳当代艺术与城市规划馆
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Civic Center (3 stops) + 340 m walk
why: Free, no booking, Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00 (closed Mondays). Giant city model + the 改革开放 exhibition; striking building.

name: WonderMeet
nearest_metro: Huaqiang Rd 华强路 (L1), exit B — direct B1 passage to 世纪汇
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Convention & Exhibition Center → L1 Huaqiang Rd (2 + 2 stops)
why: 世纪汇广场, 深南中路3018号. ¥268 weekday / ¥298 weekend, 10:00–22:00, wristband re-entry all day. Go-karts, laser tag, ice rink, PS5/Switch, KTV pods, arcade, bowling. Night ticket ¥168 after 19:00. Join their WeChat group for 20 free claw coins.

name: SEG Electronics Market
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Convention & Exhibition Center → L1 Huaqiang Rd → walk 300 m
why: 华强北路1002号. Six floors of components, phones, laptops, drones, repair shops — Asia's densest electronics market. Know your price before you go.

name: Mingtong Cosmetics Market
metro_plan: L4 → Convention & Exhibition Center → L1 Huaqiang Rd → L7 华强北
why: 华强北. Imported Korean/Japanese/Western cosmetics at near-duty-free prices. Check batch codes and expiry; little room to haggle on branded goods.

name: Upper Hills (深业上城)
metro_plan: L10 Futian Checkpoint → Donggualing (5 stops, direct)
why: Big open-air mall: coffee, design shops, rooftop-style lanes. A footbridge links it straight into 莲花山公园 — 15-20 min up to the Deng Xiaoping statue for the classic CBD skyline sunset, free. Best half-day: coffee here, park at golden hour.

name: Zijingcheng Food Center
nearest_metro: Huaqiangbei 华强北 (L2/L7), exit B — 380 m
metro_plan: L4 → Convention & Exhibition Center → L1 Huaqiang Rd → walk 400 m
why: 振兴路55号, 华强北. Two floors, 100+ stalls: imported snacks, nuts, drinks, gift boxes at wholesale prices even for one item. Buy a box, not a bag.

name: Shenzhen Cultural Center (Jingtian)
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Civic Center → L2 Jingtian (3 + 3 stops)
why: Neighbourhood arts centre at 景田东路2号. Check the programme; first-trip travellers can skip it.

name: Shenzhen Grand Theatre
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Civic Center → L2 Grand Theater (3 + 4 stops)
why: Only worth it with a booked performance; otherwise a pass-by near Mixc City Crossing.

name: The Mixc of Shenzhen City Crossing
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Civic Center → L2 Grand Theater (3 + 4 stops)
why: Classic luxury mall — good rain plan, food court and cinema.

name: Dong Men Ding Plaza
nearest_metro: Dongmen 东门 (L5) / Laojie 老街 (L1/L3)
metro_plan: As DMD Food City, then 230 m walk
why: Generic mall attached to the food city — useful only as a shortcut or an AC break.

name: DMD Food City (东门町美食城)
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Convention & Exhibition Center → L1 Laojie (2 + 5 stops)
why: Dense snack stalls in Dongmen; the best cheap eating on the list. Go hungry, in the evening.

name: Dongmen Pedestrian Street
nearest_metro: Hubei 湖贝 (L2/L5) / Laojie 老街 (L1/L3)
metro_plan: L4 Futian Checkpoint → Civic Center → L2 Hubei (3 + 5 stops)
why: Shenzhen's original bargain-shopping street. Loud, cheap, snack-heavy — 1-2 h is plenty.

name: Dongmen Baima Fashion Market
nearest_metro: Laojie 老街 (L1/L3), exit A — 5 min
metro_plan: L1 Laojie from Huaqiang Rd (2 stops)
why: 鸿展商城, 东门步行街, 6 floors: 2F women's, 3-4F men's, 5F export surplus. Some stalls want 2+ pieces. Best 16:00-18:00 when they clear stock.

name: Shuibei Jewelry Center
chinese_name: 水贝国际珠宝交易中心
metro_plan: L7 Huanggangcun → 水贝 (5 stops, direct) + 10 min walk
why: Shenzhen processes most of China's gold here. Price = weight + labour fee (工费) — always ask the 工费 separately and ask for a certificate. Weekdays are calmer.

name: MixC World 万象天地 (Nanshan)
metro_plan: L7 Huanggangcun → Chegongmiao → L1 Hi-Tech Park (4 + 6 stops)
why: Best-designed mall in town: outdoor lanes, flagships, strong restaurant floor.

name: Shenzhen Talent Park
metro_plan: L7 Huanggangcun → Chegongmiao → L11 Houhai → L13 Talent Park
why: Free bay-front loop with the Houhai skyline. Best light 17:00-18:30; pair with dinner in Houhai. Metro: 人才公园 Exit.

name: Shenzhen Poly Cultural Plaza
metro_plan: L7 Huanggangcun → Chegongmiao → L11 Houhai (4 + 2 stops)
why: Local mall/theatre by Talent Park — a convenience stop, not a destination.

name: Nanyou Clothing Market
metro_plan: L11 Chegongmiao → 南油 (3 stops) or DiDi
why: 南海大道南油第一工业区 — dozens of buildings of original-design women's wear, Korean/European labels, higher quality than Dongmen. 10:00-19:00.

name: Nantou Ancient City
nearest_metro: Nantou Ancient City 南头古城 (L12)
metro_plan: L7 Huanggangcun → Chegongmiao → L1 Taoyuan → L12 Nantou Ancient City (2 changes)
why: Restored old village turned shopping street. Your contact found it thin — treat it as a coffee/food stop (1.5-2 h), not a headline sight.

name: Happy Harbour
metro_plan: L7 Huanggangcun → Chegongmiao → L11 Qianhai Bay → L5 Linhai
why: 'Bay Glory' wheel ¥150 (¥180 holidays), 10:30-22:00. Promenade + evening light show. Metro: 临海 Exit B2.
